ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given $\angle AOB$ and $\angle COD$, the ray $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$; as shown in Figure 1, given $\angle AOB = 180^\circ$ and $\angle COD = 90^\circ$, if $\angle DOB = 46^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle COE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\angle AOB=180^\circ$ and $\angle DOB=46^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle AOD=134^\circ$. \\
Since $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$, \\
we have $\angle EOD=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOD=\frac{1}{2}\times 134^\circ=67^\circ$. \\
Given $\angle COD=90^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle COE=\angle COD-\angle EOD=90^\circ-67^\circ=\boxed{23^\circ}$.
